name: MidKar Jazz MIDI
description: Large jazz archive with 778 MIDI files covering swing, bebop, bossa nova, big band, and many Great American Songbook standards.

name: Les Gorven Jazz Standards
description: Directly accessible MIDI arrangements of classic jazz and Songbook titles such as A Fine Romance, A Foggy Day, Ain't Misbehavin', and All the Things You Are.

name: Josef Huber Jazz MIDI
description: Personal MIDI collection of jazz standards, Broadway songs, and Songbook pieces, including Body and Soul, I Got Rhythm, My Funny Valentine, and Take the A Train.

name: bTd Big Band MIDI
description: Compact big-band and swing collection featuring Glenn Miller, Ellington, Tommy Dorsey, and other well-known standards.

name: bTd Ragtime & Standards MIDI
description: Small direct MIDI collection spanning ragtime, early swing, and standards such as Anything Goes, Cherokee, Sweet Georgia Brown, and Bye Bye Blues.

name: Hotclub Powertab
description: Gypsy jazz, swing, and Hot Club arrangements available as directly downloadable PowerTab files.

name: Guitar Jazz Tabs PTB
description: A small selection of fully arranged jazz and pop standards for guitar in PowerTab format.

name: Jass and Chansons
description: Jazz standards and chansons for guitar, with MIDI, PowerTab, and Guitar Pro files.

name: Classical Midi
description: Classical guitar music in MIDI format, organized by composer and featuring many historical works.

name: Classtab WEB FL
description: Classical guitar pieces and exercises, mainly as MIDI and ASCII tablature, organized by composer.

name: Onefish Classical MIDI
description: Small classical MIDI collection featuring multi-movement works by Johann Sebastian Bach.

name: Acoustic Fingerstyle
description: Fingerstyle arrangements for acoustic guitar as MIDI files across a variety of styles.

name: Tallstrom Fingerstyle GP5
description: Around 40 directly downloadable fingerstyle arrangements and original compositions in Guitar Pro 5 format, with Chet Atkins influences, country picking, open tunings, and familiar melodies.

name: GPA Chet Atkins Fingerstyle TEF
description: Extensive Chet Atkins collection with more than 120 directly downloadable TablEdit files, including country fingerpicking, jazz standards, ragtime, and familiar arrangements.

name: Duane Langston Fingerstyle TEF
description: More than 350 personal fingerstyle guitar arrangements in TablEdit format, including jazz and Songbook standards, folk, film music, and popular melodies.

name: AcousticPower
description: Acoustic guitar arrangements in PowerTab format, including fingerstyle, classical, blues, and pieces by Chet Atkins.

name: Steve McWilliam TEF & MIDI
description: Large mixed guitar collection covering ragtime, folk, classical, and popular pieces, provided in both TEF and MIDI formats.

name: Martin Blake TEF
description: Flatpicking, folk, blues, and traditional guitar arrangements available as directly downloadable TablEdit files.

name: Mandozine Mandolin TEF
description: Nearly 3,000 mandolin tablatures in TEF format, covering bluegrass, Celtic, jazz, old-time, classical, waltzes, and other styles.

name: Banjr TEF & MIDI
description: Very large collection of American fiddle tunes for five-string banjo, mostly provided as matching TablEdit and MIDI files.

name: Banjo Hangout
description: Large banjo archive covering bluegrass, clawhammer, old-time, folk, and classical music, with many entries available as TEF or MIDI files.

name: BanjoBluegrass.fr TEF
description: Alphabetically organized five-string banjo collection with bluegrass, folk, and traditional pieces in TEF format.

name: Strum Hollow TEF
description: Old-time and fiddle tunes as TEF arrangements for banjo, dobro, dulcimer, fiddle, guitar, and mandolin.

name: Dulcimertab TEF & MIDI
description: Extensive mountain dulcimer catalog featuring folk songs, hymns, traditional tunes, and standards in TEF and MIDI formats.

name: GuitarProTabs.org
description: Large archive of popular songs in various Guitar Pro formats, organized by artist and title.

name: GProTab
description: Searchable online catalog of popular Guitar Pro tablatures with previews and file-based downloads.
